tasks.title: CSS Foundation + LQIP Utility + MascotBackground Component
tasks.description: Create globals.css mascot variables, mascot-lqip.ts utility, and MascotBackground.tsx component with unit tests. Establishes the visual primitive.

produces: lib/hestia/mascot-lqip.ts: generateLQIP(mascotKey) → { lqipBase64: string, blurHash?: string }

acceptanceCriteria: globals.css defines all mascot CSS variables with correct defaults (hestia prominent)
prefers-reduced-motion media query sets --mascot-transition-duration: 0ms
generateLQIP('hestia') returns valid base64 1x1px PNG data URI
MascotBackground renders a div with inline --mascot-bg-lqip style
MascotBackground applies mode via --mascot-bg-opacity (1 vs 0.12)
MascotBackground adds transition class for cross-fade
Watermark mode uses content-visibility: auto
Prominent mode includes ::before overlay with --mascot-overlay-bg and text color --mascot-overlay-text
Unit tests pass: LQIP generation, component render modes, CSS var application

tasks.title: Extend MascotProvider + create useMascotBackground Hook
tasks.description: Add previousMascotKey tracking to MascotProvider context. Create useMascotBackground hook that derives mode (prominent/watermark) from page data state and provides transition class.

produces: MascotProvider context extended with previousMascotKey: MascotKey | null
useMascotBackground(dataState) → { mascotKey, previousMascotKey, mode, transitionClass, lqipStyle }

acceptanceCriteria: MascotProvider tracks previousMascotKey on pathname change (useEffect + ref)
Cross-fade transitionClass = 'mascot-transition' normally, 'mascot-transition-reduced' when prefers-reduced-motion
useMascotBackground('loading') → mode='prominent'
useMascotBackground('empty') → mode='prominent'
useMascotBackground('error') → mode='prominent'
useMascotBackground('has-data') → mode='watermark'
lqipStyle contains --mascot-bg-lqip for current mascotKey
Unit tests pass: provider transition tracking, hook mode derivation, reduced-motion detection
